Title: Legacy Items (Hand-me-downs)
Description:
[h1][b][i]Your predecessors left behind more for you than just their tombstones.[/i][/b][/h1]

[b]Adds a "hand-me-down" legacy item system to the game to add a tiny bit of meta-progression.[/b]

(This mod contains scripts, so you might have to [i]Options → Modding → Allow scripting mods[/i] and restart the game.)

[h2]What this mod does[/h2]

The mod introduces the concept of a "legacy item pool", to which your characters contribute one or more of their items upon death, and from which you can choose [i]one[/i] item to start with on your next run.

[h3]During character creation[/h3]

Pick one item from your legacy item pool, before you choose your genotype. When you start the game with the selected item, it is removed from the pool for future runs.

[h3]On character death[/h3]

When your character dies, the mod selects one or more* items (both from your equipped items and your inventory) to add to the legacy item pool.

The selection happens automatically, and is semi-random with a bias towards higher-value items (based on item tier, artifact complexity, and commerce value), and an additional bias towards equipped items. You're more [i]likely[/i] to carry your most advanced worn artifact forward than that half-burnt torch in your inventory, but there's no guarantee.

Items are added to the pool with all their permanent modifiers preserved (mods, charge, ammo, liquid content for containers, custom names, stack sizes). Items are not eligible for being added to the pool if they are natural weapons (claws and such).

For Roleplay runs, items will only be added to the pool when a character is retired permanently, not if they die and restore a checkpoint.

* You're guaranteed at least one item drop, but the mod has a (initially high, but rapidly diminishing) chance to "proc" additional item drops. 

[h3]Legacy item pool management[/h3]

There is a maximum of 25 items allowed in the legacy item pool. If new items are added to the pool that exceed the limit, the oldest items in the pool are removed to make room. You can discard items from the pool during character creation.

The pool is pre-seeded with several low-value items when you first install the mod, so that you can see how it works immediately during character creation without first having to retire a character.
